llm.summary: This skill is a coherent voice-writing helper with some activation and transparency caveats, but no evidence of hidden, destructive, or unrelated behavior.

dimensions.detail: Reading ~/.claude/voice-profiles and a project .voice/override.md is purpose-aligned for voice generation, but users should understand it uses local profile and project voice files.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown instructions only, with no executable installer or script; metadata discloses optional companion Night Market/OpenClaw requirements.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger list includes broad terms like voice, generation, and writing, so the skill could activate in more conversations than intended; the actual instructions remain scoped to voice-matched drafting.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill mentions saving pre-review or post-review snapshots only when learning mode is active, with no evidence of background workers, credential use, network transfer, or unbounded persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe generating text from an existing voice profile, register, source framing, banned-phrase cleanup, and optional review.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the agent reading your local voice profile files and applying automatic style cleanup before presenting drafts. Review generated text yourself, especially when the writing represents a real person or authorial voice.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad triggers are over-scoped for a specific voice-generation skill, but this is an activation-quality issue rather than evidence of malicious or high-impact behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Silent cleanup of banned phrases and punctuation fits the stated style-generation purpose, though users should be aware the draft may be modified before review.
